Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating access to confidential court records.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to confidential court records; adding a new sectionto chapter 2.28 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 2.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No employee of a court, county clerk's office, governmentagency, the administrative office of the courts, or any other personunder contract with any such agency may intentionally access, use, ordisclose court records that he or she knows to be confidential, unlessauthorized. (2) A court record is confidential if access to that record isrestricted by statute, court order, or court rules. (3) For the purposes of this section, "authorized" means access:(a) For the purpose of conducting official court business for a usespecifically permitted by employment status; (b) by court order, courtrule, or statute for the use specified; or (c) by contractual provisioncontained in an agreement between the official custodian of the court p. 1 SSB 6496record and another person or entity, as specified in such agreement. (4) Violation of this section is a gross misdemeanor.
